about: Lineup results that draft_assistant/slot_assignment.py (the engine) and buildLineup/getRosterNeeds in draft_assistant/web/static/components/shared-utils.js (the browser) must both reproduce.

Generated from the Python side - never edit by hand. tests/test_lineup_parity.py fails when this file is stale and checks every case against an exhaustive search; scripts/check_lineup_parity.js replays it through the browser code.

Each roster lists its slots once. A case's players are [id, pos, projPts]; points are distinct within a case, so exactly one lineup is best. Grid case names are the QB/RB/WR/TE counts; draft case names are <script>@<picks made>.
starters: ids in the best lineup. points: their total. open: starter slots still empty (IR is a roster slot but never a lineup slot). bench: ids seated on BN/BENCH when spares outnumber the seats.

needs: positions where one more player would fill another starter slot. getRosterNeeds returns this list; Python's needs_by_position counts open slots per roster key instead, so its comparable reading is 'adding this position lowers the total'.
Not pinned, because neither side defines it: which of several overlapping flex slots is the empty one, and the order of equally valued players.
